lista.titulo: The Tulip Bubble
lista.descripcion: The burst of the enormous tulip bubble in 1637 Netherlands serves as reminder of how quickly financial holdings and futures can rise or drop.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Like Button: The Unintended Consenquences of the Facebook Like Button
lista.descripcion: Like Button: The Unintended Consenquences of the Facebook Like Button ║ When first presented with the like button Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg worried that a quick thumbs up or down would discourage more meaningful online interaction but eventually his team changed his mind and transformed the world.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Cubicle: How the Cubicle Became Universally Hated
lista.descripcion: Cubicle: How the Cubicle Became Universally Hated ║ The Cubicle was originally designed to set workers free; a futuristic designer named Robert Propst dreamed up the cubicle as a groovy 1960s workplace utopia that would unleash the modern knowledge worker's vast untapped potential.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Barcode: How the Barcode Shaped Our Modern Economy
lista.descripcion: Barcode: How the Barcode Shaped Our Modern Economy ║ Barcodes have radically changed global commerce, helping fuel the rise of everything from massive companies like Walmart to world powers like China, and it all started with a man daydreaming on a beach in 1949.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Florida: How Real Estate Rogues Invented Florida as We Know It
lista.descripcion: Florida: How Real Estate Rogues Invented Florida as We Know It ║ Florida wasn't always the Sunshine State; in the 1920s, an army of real estate boosters set out to redefine Florida from an economic backwater to a ritzy vacation destination, sparking a land boom the likes of which America had never seen before.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Mauve: The Fake Color That Made Our Modern World
lista.descripcion: Mauve: The Fake Color That Made Our Modern World ║ In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue; Mauve takes over the fashion industry, make food look more appetizing, and enable stunning advances in medicine.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Vanilla: The Bean That Shaped the Future of Food
lista.descripcion: Vanilla: The Bean That Shaped the Future of Food ║ In 1841 on the small island of Réunion, a 12-year-old slave did something no one had done before; the vanilla bean takes the world by storm, sparking the artificial flavor revolution and forever changing how we eat.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • The Hollywood Actress That Laid the Groundwork for WiFi
lista.descripcion: The Hollywood Actress That Laid the Groundwork for WiFi ║ During WWII, Actress Hedy Lamarr, deemed the world's most beautiful woman, invented a technology that laid the groundwork for the wireless internet of today.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Streaming: The Invention That Revolutionized Streaming Video
lista.descripcion: Streaming: The Invention That Revolutionized Streaming Video ║ The early days of online video were plagued by low resolution, stamp-sized video, and unbearable buffering times but that changed when a breakthrough technology revolutionized streaming video and set the foundation for the era of Netflix.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Interstate: How the Interstate Connected and Divided America
lista.descripcion: Interstate: How the Interstate Connected and Divided America ║ Dwight Eisenhower's interstate highway system was the biggest infrastructure project of its time, a bold plan to connect all corners of America and boost the post-war economy, but it also ended up deepening the divide between rich and poor.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Edison: How Edison Reinvented Invention
lista.descripcion: Edison: How Edison Reinvented Invention ║ Edison pioneered the world's first research and development center in Menlo Park and worked with a group of experimenters to methodically zero in on the holy grail of electric light.
